# Smallest certifiable alpha (generated by scripts/alpha_floor.py)

delta = 0.05; Calibrate sizes from `splits/splits_v1.json` (r=13 has no Calibrate shots).

| Setting | Kept Calibrate shots n | Smallest alpha, 0 errors | Smallest alpha if true R = 0.001 |
|---|---|---|---|
| One experiment, keep all | 15,000 | 2.0e-04 | 1.5e-03 |
| One experiment, keep 50% | 7,500 | 4.0e-04 | 1.9e-03 |
| d=3, one round count, 18 patch-basis experiments pooled, keep all | 270,000 | 1.1e-05 | 1.1e-03 |
| d=5, one round count, 8 patch-basis experiments pooled, keep all | 120,000 | 2.5e-05 | 1.2e-03 |
| d=7, one round count, 2 patch-basis experiments pooled, keep all | 30,000 | 1.0e-04 | 1.4e-03 |

Pooling assumes the pooled experiments are exchangeable, which is what RQ3 tests; report pooled guarantees only with that assumption stated.
